nodes.description: Reflection balance mapping _rOwned: address => uint256 used for all internal accounting.
Constant total token supply _tTotal = 1e9 * 10**9.
Total reflections _rTotal, decreased whenever fees are reflected.
Payable marketing wallet that receives ETH from swaps.
Uniswap V2 router interface used for swaps and liquidity.
Uniswap V2 pair address created for this token.
Flag that gates transfers until trading is enabled by the owner.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by the lockTheSwap modifier.
Flag controlling whether the automatic contract-token swap runs.
Maximum token amount allowed per transaction.
Maximum token balance allowed per wallet.
Contract token balance threshold that triggers a swap.
Current reflection fee applied during transfers.
Current team/tax fee applied during transfers.
Blacklist mapping marking addresses blocked from transfers.
Mapping of addresses excluded from fee deduction.
Owner address assigned in the Ownable constructor from msg.sender.
ERC20 allowance mapping owner => spender => amount.
Accumulated total of fee tokens distributed to holders.
constructor: mints all reflections to deployer, sets router, pair and marketing address.
transfer(address,uint256): moves tokens from msg.sender to recipient.
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): moves tokens using allowance.
approve(address,uint256): sets allowance from msg.sender.
_transfer(address,address,uint256): core transfer logic with limits, blacklist and swap trigger.
swapTokensForEth(uint256): approves and swaps contract tokens for ETH via the router.
sendETHToFee(uint256): forwards ETH held by the contract to the marketing address.
manualswap(): marketing-only function to swap the whole contract token balance.
manualsend(): marketing-only function to forward all contract ETH to the fee wallet.
setTrading(bool): owner-only switch enabling trading.
setFee(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256): owner-only fee update with weak invariant check.
blockBots(address[]): owner-only loop adding addresses to the blacklist.
unblockBot(address): owner-only removal from the blacklist.
setMaxTxnAmount(uint256): owner-only update of the max transaction limit.
setMaxWalletSize(uint256): owner-only update of the max wallet size.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees(address[],bool): owner-only bulk fee-exclusion update.
_tokenTransfer(...): optionally disables fees around the standard transfer.
_transferStandard(...): computes values and updates reflection balances, team and fees.
_takeTeam(uint256): credits the team share to the contract address.
_reflectFee(uint256,uint256): reduces _rTotal and grows _tFeeTotal.
tokenFromReflection(uint256): converts reflection amount to token amount.
balanceOf(address): returns token balance derived from reflections.
_getValues(uint256): aggregates T and R value computation for a transfer.
_getRate(): returns rSupply / tSupply.
_getCurrentSupply(): returns the current rSupply and tSupply.
_approve(address,address,uint256): internal allowance writer.
toggleSwap(bool): owner-only switch for the automatic swap.
setMinSwapTokensThreshold(uint256): owner-only swap threshold update.
transferOwnership(address): owner-only ownership handover.
renounceOwnership(): owner-only renunciation of ownership.
msg.sender / _msgSender(): external caller-controlled address.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value used as swap deadline.
External call uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with deadline block.timestamp.
ETH transfer _marketingAddress.transfer(amount): pushes ETH to an external address.
Reflection/fee arithmetic (mul, div, sub, add on rAmount/tFee/rTotal) executed on every transfer.
recipient parameter of transfer(address,uint256).
amount parameter of transfer(address,uint256).
sender parameter of transferFrom(address,address,uint256).
recipient parameter of transferFrom(address,address,uint256).
spender parameter of approve(address,uint256).
from parameter of _transfer(address,address,uint256).
to parameter of _transfer(address,address,uint256).
tokenAmount parameter of swapTokensForEth(uint256).
bots_ array parameter of blockBots(address[]).
amount parameter of sendETHToFee(uint256).
notbot parameter of unblockBot(address).
maxTxAmount parameter of setMaxTxnAmount(uint256).
maxWalletSize parameter of setMaxWalletSize(uint256).
contractTokenBalance local variable in _transfer compared to swap threshold and max tx.
takeFee boolean local variable in _transfer passed to _tokenTransfer.
path address[] local variable used in swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance local variable used to decide the ETH payout in _transfer.
rAmount local variable returned by _getValues in _transferStandard.
tTransferAmount local variable returned by _getValues in _transferStandard.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the from address of _transfer, so a caller-controlled address drives balance accounting and gating checks.
Constructor uses _msgSender() to mint _rOwned and to assign _marketingAddress.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender when decrementing allowance.
manualswap authorizes on _msgSender() == _marketingAddress.
manualsend authorizes on _msgSender() == _marketingAddress.
The owner state variable is initialized from msg.sender in the Ownable constructor.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, making the call timestamp dependent.
Constructor assigns the router address to uniswapV2Router.
Constructor creates and stores the uniswapV2Pair address.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard for the actual balance updates.
_transferStandard credits the team share via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_getValues reads the current rate from _getRate.
_getRate obtains supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
balanceOf converts reflections through tokenFromReflection.
_transfer calls balanceOf to read contract and recipient balances.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth when the contract balance exceeds the threshold.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee after the swap when the contract holds ETH.
swapTokensForEth hands execution to the external Uniswap router mid-transfer.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to _marketingAddress, which can reenter the token.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the full contract ETH balance.
_transferStandard performs reflection sub/add arithmetic on balances that can underflow or drift.
_tokenTransfer toggles fees that feed directly into the fee arithmetic of the transfer.
_marketingAddress is the beneficiary used by sendETHToFee.
_marketingAddress is the target of the ETH transfer unsafe operation.
uniswapV2Router provides WETH and the swap entry point.
uniswapV2Pair determines buy/sell direction and the wallet-size check.
tradingOpen gates whether non-owner transfers are permitted.
inSwap guard suppresses nested swap execution inside _transfer.
swapEnabled controls whether the automatic swap branch runs.
_maxTxAmount bounds transfer amount and the amount forwarded to the swap.
_maxWalletSize caps the recipient balance.
_swapTokensAtAmount is the trigger threshold for the swap branch.
bots blacklist blocks sender or recipient in _transfer.
_isExcludedFromFee decides takeFee and whether the swap branch is allowed.
_redisFee is read by _getValues for the reflection share.
_taxFee is read by _getValues for the team share.
_transferStandard reads and writes _rOwned balances.
_reflectFee subtracts the fee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee accumulates the fee into _tFeeTotal.
transferFrom reads _allowances to validate the spending amount.
_approve writes the new allowance into _allowances.
balanceOf reads _rOwned for the requested account.
_getCurrentSupply uses _tTotal as the token supply.
recipient parameter is forwarded into _transfer by transfer.
amount parameter is forwarded into _transfer by transfer.
sender parameter is the source address of the transferFrom transfer.
recipient parameter is the destination address of the transferFrom transfer.
spender parameter is written by approve into the allowance mapping.
from parameter drives blacklist, trading and pair checks in _transfer.
to parameter drives wallet-size and pair checks in _transfer.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped by swapTokensForEth.
bots_ array elements are written into the bots blacklist.
amount parameter is transferred to the marketing address by sendETHToFee.
notbot parameter is cleared in the bots blacklist.
maxTxAmount parameter is validated and stored into _maxTxAmount.
maxWalletSize parameter is stored into _maxWalletSize.
contractTokenBalance controls whether the swap branch is entered.
takeFee decides between removeAllFee/restoreAllFee around the transfer.
path array defines the token/WETH swap route.
contractETHBalance is forwarded to sendETHToFee.
rAmount is subtracted from the sender reflection balance in _transferStandard.
tTransferAmount is emitted as the transfer value in _transferStandard.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is a direct argument of transfer and has no meaning outside it.
amount is a direct argument of transfer and is only used for the delegated _transfer call.
sender is a direct argument of transferFrom used to pick the debited account.
recipient is a direct argument of transferFrom used to pick the credited account.
spender is a direct argument of approve written straight into _allowances.
from is a direct argument of _transfer that drives blacklist and pair checks.
to is a direct argument of _transfer that drives wallet-size and pair checks.
tokenAmount is a direct argument of swapTokensForEth approved to the router.
bots_ is a direct argument of blockBots and is fully consumed by its loop.
amount is a direct argument of sendETHToFee and is only used for the ETH push.
notbot is a direct argument of unblockBot cleared in the blacklist mapping.
maxTxAmount is a direct argument of setMaxTxnAmount stored into _maxTxAmount.
maxWalletSize is a direct argument of setMaxWalletSize stored into _maxWalletSize.
local computed inside _transfer solely to size the swap call.
local computed inside _transfer and passed directly to _tokenTransfer.
local swap route array built only for the router call in swapTokensForEth.
local ETH balance read inside _transfer only to feed sendETHToFee.
local reflection amount returned by _getValues and consumed inside _transferStandard.
local token amount returned by _getValues and emitted inside _transferStandard.
